newsitem.title: CHINA: China's B indices end mixed.
newsitem.headline: China's B indices end mixed.

text.p: China's B share indices closed mixed on Friday with Shanghai's market falling on a correction and Shenzhen advancing in line with the A share market on buying in shares expected to post solid results, brokers said.
Shanghai's B share index closed down 0.270 points or 0.41 percent to 65.157 points, but Shenzhen's B index edged up 0.19 points or 0.13 percent to close at 149.05 points.
Shanghai brokers said profit-taking pushed the index down following a jump on Thursday but it could still rebound to test a higher level over the next few sessions.
Hotel group Shanghai Jinjiang Tower was the biggest loser on expectations of unpromising results, slipping $0.018 or 6.04 percent to $0.280 on volume of 158,800 shares.

Tientsin Marine Shipping was the most active share and closed up on speculative buying ahead of the close despite falls for most of the session, rising $0.002 or 0.39 percent to $0.512 on volume of 1.8 million shares.
Meanwhile, Shenzhen's B shares rose on Friday in line with their A share counterparts with investors building positions in counters that were expected to post solid earnings for 1996, brokers said.
Beverage maker Shenbao performed strongest and surged HK$0.35 or 6.54 percent to HK$5.70 on trade of 390,510 shares.

Property issue Hainan Pearl River was the most active counter on volume of 1.65 million shares, rising HK$0.07 to HK$3.31, lifted by investor optimism over the firm's unreleased 1996 results, brokers said.
On the A share markets, the indices in both Shanghai and Shenzhen reversed slight morning losses to close up on selective buying, brokers said.
Shanghai's A share index rose 8.86 points or 0.89 percent to 995.50 points and Shenzhen's A index gained 2.29 points or 0.63 percent to end at 364.69 points.
In Shanghai, Shanghai Shenhua Industry was the star on rumours of a bonus offer, soaring 10 percent to its limit-up of 15.27 yuan on volume of 6.8 million shares.
In Shenzhen, Datong Cement Co Ltd, which listed 13.50 million A shares in Shenzhen on Friday, closed at 16.06 yuan in trade of 11.22 million shares compared with a recent offer price of 7.15 yuan.
Hotelier Dalian Friendship (Group) Co Ltd, which floated 35 million A shares in Shenzhen on Friday, ended the session at 16.93 yuan. The shares were issued at 9.80 yuan each earlier this month.
